description: MECHANISM: ONLY a `repeat` body encloses — `forever` does not (issue #1155). The checker's headline claim is "a `repeat` body encloses; nothing else does", and until this fixture nothing in the corpus tested the negative half of it: a rule that treated any loop as enclosing would pass every other repcount fixture. `forever` is the sharpest case because it IS a loop and reads like one, yet the evaluator only ever pushes a turn for `Repeat`, so `repcount` inside it has nothing to report. Measured against the evaluator: this program raises `ol-repcount-outside-repeat` at `runtime` after 2 events. `check: true` rather than `execute: true` deliberately — a real `forever` never terminates, so it cannot be an executed fixture (see `packages/runtime/src/repeat-forever-repcount.test.mjs`, which reaches `forever`'s mechanics only through a test-only iteration cap).
